canonical.question: What vehicle-reservation requirement and standard-pass price range does the National Park Service Yellowstone fees and passes give?
canonical.expected_primary: Although an entrance pass is required to enter Yellowstone National Park, vehicle reservations are not needed.

canonical.tampered_primary: Vehicle reservations are required for every Yellowstone entry.
